title: Dadology - Videos
description: Given my innate versatility, formal education but also informal (life is the best school), education through various forums and portals, attending several professional symposia in a cafe near the Park where all the neighborhood intellectual team gathered, I try to express my views daily and the idea of resolving the global crisis. It is the most desirable commodity today. Almost like Brangelina used to be. And my solutions are wise, spiritual and the best.
